answer: Agents could gate influence on a pulse of randomly timed, unpredictable tasks that each identity must answer using a costly, nontransferable stake. The system checks consistency across answers and slashes stake for duplicate or coordinated responses, while rotating task themes from tundra ecology to lotus cultivation makes precomputed replies less useful. A Sybil attacker must therefore lock up real capital and maintain many distinct, responsive agents; creating cheap fake accounts alone yields no extra influence.
